access.login_failure.description: Customers are unable to log in, with password entry rejected and login blocked by ads.
access.login_failure.name: Cannot log into account

billing.premium_only_restrictions.description: Customers feel basic features like choosing specific songs and skipping are now restricted to premium subscribers.
billing.premium_only_restrictions.name: Features locked behind premium

catalog.lyrics.description: Customers find lyrics appear for some songs but not others, or fail to display at all.
catalog.lyrics.name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent

catalog.missing_content.description: Customers report that many songs and certain genres such as gospel music are not available.
catalog.missing_content.name: Songs and genres missing

catalog.recommendations_shuffle.description: Customers do not want recommended content inserted into their own playlists and feel recommendations have degraded.
catalog.recommendations_shuffle.name: Unwanted recommendations interrupting playlists

downloads.download_failure.description: Customers find song downloads stall in the background until the app is reopened.
downloads.download_failure.name: Downloads get stuck

downloads.offline_mode.description: Customers report that offline mode does not function as expected.
downloads.offline_mode.name: Offline mode not working

other.general_criticism.description: Customers broadly criticize the app as worst or useless, especially after a recent update, without naming a specific problem.
other.general_criticism.name: General dissatisfaction with app

playback.audio_quality.description: Customers find music audio adjustment settings do not work properly.
playback.audio_quality.name: Audio adjustment settings not working

playback.connection_errors.description: Customers cannot connect over Wi-Fi although mobile data works.
playback.connection_errors.name: Wi-Fi connection failures

playback.crashes.description: Customers report the app crashes after updates or gets stuck on the loading screen.
playback.crashes.name: App crashes or freezes on launch

playback.device_integration.description: Customers say Google Assistant reports playing their Spotify playlist but no songs play.
playback.device_integration.name: Google Assistant playback failure

playback.stops_or_pauses.description: Customers find music keeps stopping partway through songs and does not resume where it left off.
playback.stops_or_pauses.name: Playback stops midway

usability.ads_frequency.description: Customers feel ads play too often, between nearly every song, and are too loud, pushing them toward premium.
usability.ads_frequency.name: Excessive and loud ads

usability.controls_widgets.description: Customers lost basic player controls such as skipping, going back, repeating, or replaying a specific part of a song.

usability.other.name: Playlist plays songs randomly

usability.playlist_queue_management.description: Customers cannot play chosen songs, queue tracks, or skip freely, and are forced through shuffled playlists.
usability.playlist_queue_management.name: Cannot choose or queue songs

usability.ui_redesign.description: Customers dislike the new homescreen design and automatically playing audio elements that cannot be turned off.
usability.ui_redesign.name: Disliked homescreen redesign and autoplay
